text:
eli: quick async note after the postmortem for the key-orchestration failure. i'm capturing owners, short ETAs, and the lightweight checks we'll run. please ack and add gaps.

parul: ack. i'll take rotation-verification automation and the gating rule.

omar: ack. i'll own token validation hardening + tests.

jun: ack. i'll do audit enrichment, dashboards, and alerts.

eli: initial remediation items (compact):
- ROV1: implement preflight secret existence check across envs and fail rotation PRs if missing (owner: parul, ETA: 10d)
- ROV2: add stricter validation in auth-proxy (sig/kid/exp + explicit kid lookup failure metric) (owner: omar, ETA: 12d)
- ROV3: rotation verification matrix and CI job (preflight + post-rotate smoke + canary watch) (owner: parul, ETA: 14d)
- ROV4: audit log fields + retention bump to 45d + saved queries for investigation (owner: jun, ETA: 5d)
- ROV5: alerting + runbook link on token failure spikes (>0.4% / 15m) (owner: jun, ETA: 7d)
- ROV6: add ephemeral credential checker to rotation pipeline to validate new keys within 30m post-rotate (owner: parul, ETA: 14d)

parul: preflight plan (short): ops-cli secrets verify --name=auth_pub --env=all || exit 1. Gate will block merge and tag PR with reason.

example (CI step):
```
# verify secret exists in prod/stage/canary
ops-cli secrets verify --name=auth_pub --env=prod,stage,canary || exit 1
```

omar: for ROV2 i'll add unit + integration tests to simulate bad kid, missing kid, expired token, and clock skew. test snippet: 
```
POST /v1/auth/validate
{ "token": "eyJ...bad-kid" }
expect: 401, metric: validation.kid_mismatch
```
ETA for PR: 2024-08-03.

jun: audit changes: sample auth_flow at 35% for 30d initially; add token_kid, client_id, validation_result. saving two queries: recent_failures_1m and rotation_error_trend_1d. PR: 2024-07-29.

parul: rotation verification matrix (high level):
1) preflight: secret presence check + config diff validation
2) post-merge: trigger canary rotate in region-a, run full smoke (token exchange, sign/verify) within 20m
3) canary watch: monitor validation.failure_rate; if >0.2% over 1h block rollout
4) rollback hook: auto-rollback on smoke failure or canary metric regressions

ops-bot: Created ticket SEC-5012: "rotation-verification-matrix" assignee: parul. Calendar "rotation-checks" created weekly Weds 09:30 PT for 8 weeks.

eli: recurrence note: ops reviewed last 9 months and saw 3 clusters tied to vendor rotation windows and manual rotation windows. root causes: orchestration race + insufficient preflight and no canary watch. primary fixes = ROV1..ROV6.

jun: alerting: page on-call at 0.5% sustained 15m; create #token-ops channel for triage; include runbook link in payload: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/token-rotations.

omar: canary rollout plan: 48-72h canary with metric guard. if guard trips, rollback and open incident.

parul: gating detail: PRs must pass preflight job and the job will post a status check with the verification matrix results. label PRs with "incident-1743216543-remediate".

jun: will add dashboard tile and alerts. saved query links will be pasted here when PR is up.

parul: PRs: rotation job WIP https://redwood.internal/pull/5201 (includes gating). target merge 2024-08-12.

omar: validation hardening draft PR: https://redwood.internal/pull/5207 (tests included). ETA confirmed 2024-08-03.

jun: logging/dashboard PR: https://redwood.internal/pull/5204 (ready). ETA confirmed 2024-07-29.

eli: timeline recap: ROV4 -> 5d, ROV5 -> 7d, ROV1/2 -> 10-12d, ROV3/6 -> 14d. weekly rotation checks for 8 weeks; escalate if >1 production token incident during window.

parul: will add ephemeral credential checker as a post-rotate CI hook that validates key propagation to all envs within 30m.

omar: will add metric validation.kid_mismatch.count for both canary and prod and surface on dashboards.

jun: will create alert that pages at 0.5% / 15m and also a lower-severity slack-only notification at 0.2% / 15m.

eli: final ask: owners drop PR links here and update remediation tracker sheet with final ETAs. i'll close this thread after all links are present. thanks all. :thumbsup:
